caption: A mirrored wardrobe door swings shut, and the reflected room sweeps across the mirror until it shows only the wall.

sa.check: A mirrored wardrobe door swings shut.
The reflected room sweeps across the mirror.
The mirror ends up showing only the wall.
The door moves first and the view sweeps with it.

pc.expect: The scene in the mirror slides smoothly as the door turns and changes to whatever the mirror faces.
pc.fail: It stays fixed on one view; or jumps; or shows the room when the mirror faces the wall.

pc.expect: The view changes only while the door moves.
pc.fail: It sweeps with the door still; or before the door moves; or keeps moving after the door stops.

pc.expect: The reflected room is the real room, mirrored.
pc.fail: It is a different room; or not mirrored; or objects appear that are not there.

pc.expect: The door swings in an arc on its hinges.
pc.fail: It slides; or lifts; or spins.
A second door appears; or the mirror vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The wardrobe and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The wardrobe changes colour; or the room rearranges; or the frame changes.

note: The hand closing the door is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
